62e95265c9fd030007268fb9: Wormquake!: Facing Shredder's deadly new assassin, Leo must decide whether to risk his brother's lives or ask for Splinter's help. Donnie must put aside his rivalry with Casey in order to uncover a new Kraang plot.
Within the Woods: The team comes to grips with the possibility that Leo won't get better, while things only get worse: a new mutant captures Raph!
A Foot Too Big: The Turtles discover Bigfoot in the woods, and Donnie befriends it, insisting they protect it from a hunter that is after it.
Buried Secrets: The team discovers a Kraang ship buried under April's house where they find… April's Mom! But as April reconnects with her lost mother, is she really all that she seems?
The Croaking: An upset Mikey runs away from home and befriends a Mutant Frog in the woods. When he learns its Frog family plans to attack the human world, he has to figure out a way to stop them.
In Dreams: Creatures that feed off dreams trap the Turtles inside their own dreams as April and Casey must find a way to wake them up.
Race with the Demon: Casey and Donnie bond over building Casey's new hot rod, but their newfound friendship is challenged by Speed Demon, a hot-rodding mutant who is terrorizing the roads.
Eyes of the Chimera: When Casey, Raph, Mikey and Donnie are captured by a new mutant, both April and Leo must overcome disabilities in order to save them.
Vision Quest: Leo takes the Turtles to train in the woods in an advanced ninja ritual where they must overcome their weaknesses and face their greatest enemies in order to become true ninja.
Return to New York: The Turtles return to the city to search for Splinter, only to find that the city is overrun with Kraang.
Serpent Hunt: As the Turtles search for Karai, they have to deal with a city filled with Kraangdroids as well as Zeck and Steranko, who hunt Karai for their own means.
The Pig and the Rhino: Donnie finishes a new batch of retro-mutagen, hoping to save Karai, but the Turtles find themselves hunted by Shredder's new vengeful henchmen… Bebop and Rocksteady!
Casey Jones VS. the Underworld: Casey Jones thinks he can take on the criminal underworld on his own, but he soon finds himself in over his head.
The Noxious Avenger: A new mutant called Muckman starts to gain notoriety as NYC's "Monster Hero".
Clash of the Mutanimals: The Shredder kidnaps and experiments on the Mighty Mutanimals.
Meet Mondo Gecko: Mikey and Casey are befriended by Mondo Gecko, a radical skateboarding reptilian kid.
The Deadly Venom: Karai is brainwashed and starts hunting the Turtles.
Turtles in Time: The Turtles get whisked through time by apprentice Time Master Renet, and they must all work together to defeat the evil Time Master Savanti Romero.
Tale of the Yokai: The Turtles are accidentally transported to the past, and they cross paths with a familiar ninja clan.
Attack of the Mega Shredder!: Leo decides to sneak into Shredder's Lair alone only to face the biggest mutant threat yet.
The Creeping Doom: After an accident, Donnie finds himself slowly losing his intelligence.
The Fourfold Trap: The Turtles are baited by an unknown enemy into deadly traps.
Dinosaur Seen in Sewers!: When Raph makes a new friend in Zog, an alien Triceraton, he may have bitten off more than he can chew.
Annihilation: Earth!: When the Turtles get word of the Kraang's return, they realize there is an even bigger threat coming to Earth!
Battle for New York: While the Mighty Mutanimals lay siege to TCRI, the Turtles must brave the bizarre world of Dimension X to save the enslaved people of New York.
Beyond the Known Universe: The Team meets a strange alien robot called the Fugitoid.
The Moons of Thalos 3: When the Team crash lands on an ice moon along with the enemy, they must put their differences aside to survive.
The Weird World of Wyrm: When Casey discovers a hypercube, he unleashes a 4th dimensional being: Wyrm.
The Outlaw Armaggon: When Lord Dregg hires a bounty hunter to destroy the Turtles, the team flees to an abandoned space station.
Riddle of the Ancient Aeons: The Turtles find themselves on a planet of pure evil.
Journey to the Center of Mikey's Mind: When microscopic aliens invade Mikey's mind, the Turtles have to chase them through the strange world of Mikey's subconscious.
The Arena of Carnage: The Turtles are captured and thrown into the Triceraton Arena!
The War for Dimension X: The Turtles have to gain the trust of the Utrom Council to find the next piece of the Black Hole Generator.
The Cosmic Ocean: The Turtles journey through an ocean-like area of space.

Angelina conta a versão dela da história. Jenni e Nicole subornam Deena para ela contar a fofoca inteira para elas. E Pauly planeja férias para a galera, e vai ser no estilo original.
A viagem para El Paso toma outro rumo quando vários boatos e rumores chegam aos ouvidos de Mike. E ele compartilha tudo no grupo de conversa e a confusão começa.
O grupo vai passar o fim de semana em El Paso para ver o show de Pauly e dançar músicas country. E é amor à primeira mordida quando Mike come seu primeiro taco texano.
A festa continua com o DJ Pauly D animando a cidade de El Paso, e as almôndegas enfrentam uma coruja. Mas é uma chamada de vídeo de Angelina que deixa Mike fora dos eixos.
As almôndegas falam com animais. Jenni destaca para todos uma causa que mora em seu coração. E Angelina tem uma conversa longa e necessária com Snooki e Deena.
A confusão finalmente atinge Mike. Primeiro, em uma discussão com Angelina e, depois, em uma discussão emotiva com Jenni.

Kaitlynn dá ao Brody a notícia de sua gravidez, mas se preocupa com o encontro cara a cara dele com o Kris no retiro. Os Pratt e os Wahler finalmente resolvem a rixa que dividiu o grupo.
